claims.claim: No published system combines synchronised dual-IMU ride characterisation with cellular telemetry on a three-wheeled cargo/passenger electric vehicle.
Camera-based hazard awareness has not been integrated with vehicle-dynamics telemetry on auto-rickshaw-class vehicles in the published or open-source literature.

Existing low-cost vehicle telematics work does not address local buffering and recovery of telemetry when the cellular uplink is intermittent, which is the normal condition in the target deployment environment.
